#SCENARIO ANALYSIS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r Scenarios}

fembloc_total_cost <- fembloc_cost_cycle0
tl_total_cost      <- tl_cost_cycle0
fr_means           <- setNames(fr$fr_mean, fr$group)

# UP state costs named vector
up_state_costs <- setNames(
  as.vector(up_probs %*% c(cost_live_birth, cost_induced_abortion,
                            cost_miscarriage, cost_ectopic_pregnancy)),
  age_groups$group
)

# Cycle 0 cost vectors — one value per age group (replicated)
fembloc_c0_vec <- rep(fembloc_total_cost, nrow(age_groups))
tl_c0_vec      <- rep(tl_total_cost,      nrow(age_groups))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RUN-SCENARIO FUNCTION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_scenario <- function(
    p_fail_fb_sc = p_fail_fembloc,
    p_fail_tl_sc = p_fail_tl,
    fb_c0_vec_sc = fembloc_c0_vec,   # vector length = nrow(age_groups)
    tl_c0_vec_sc = tl_c0_vec,
    up_costs_sc  = up_state_costs,
    crossover    = FALSE,
    label        = "Scenario"
) {

  res <- lapply(1:nrow(age_groups), function(i) {
    ag       <- age_groups[i, ]
    horizon  <- ag$horizon
    mid_age  <- ag$midpoint
    disc_r   <- ag$disc_rate
    grp      <- ag$group
    fr_start <- fr_means[grp]

    costs_fb <- numeric(horizon)
    qalys_fb <- numeric(horizon)

    # ---- FemBloc arm ----
    if (crossover) {
      prop_pc_conf <- p_confirmed
      prop_up_conf <- 0
      prop_pc_uncf <- p_unconfirmed
      prop_up_uncf <- 0
      c0_fb <- p_confirmed * fb_c0_vec_sc[i] + p_unconfirmed * tl_c0_vec_sc[i]

      for (cycle in 1:horizon) {
        current_age <- mid_age + (cycle - 1)
        current_grp <- ifelse(current_age < 30, "25-29",
                       ifelse(current_age < 35, "30-34",
                       ifelse(current_age < 40, "35-39",
                       ifelse(current_age < 45, "40-44", "45-50"))))
        fr_c        <- fr_means[current_grp]
        up_cost_now <- up_costs_sc[current_grp]
        disc_f      <- 1 / (1 + disc_r)^cycle
        hcc         <- if (cycle == 1 || cycle == horizon) 0.5 else 1.0

        u_conf    <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_fembloc else u_pc
        qaly_conf <- (prop_pc_conf * u_conf + prop_up_conf * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
        cost_conf <- prop_up_conf * up_cost_now * disc_f
        new_up_conf  <- prop_pc_conf * p_fail_fb_sc * fr_c
        prop_pc_conf <- prop_pc_conf * (1 - p_fail_fb_sc * fr_c) + prop_up_conf
        prop_up_conf <- new_up_conf

        u_uncf    <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_tl else u_pc
        qaly_uncf <- (prop_pc_uncf * u_uncf + prop_up_uncf * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
        cost_uncf <- prop_up_uncf * up_cost_now * disc_f
        new_up_uncf  <- prop_pc_uncf * p_fail_tl_sc * fr_c
        prop_pc_uncf <- prop_pc_uncf * (1 - p_fail_tl_sc * fr_c) + prop_up_uncf
        prop_up_uncf <- new_up_uncf

        qalys_fb[cycle] <- qaly_conf + qaly_uncf
        costs_fb[cycle] <- cost_conf + cost_uncf
      }

    } else {
      prop_pc_fb <- p_confirmed + p_unconfirmed * (1 - fr_start)
      prop_up_fb <- p_unconfirmed * fr_start
      c0_fb      <- fb_c0_vec_sc[i]

      for (cycle in 1:horizon) {
        current_age <- mid_age + (cycle - 1)
        current_grp <- ifelse(current_age < 30, "25-29",
                       ifelse(current_age < 35, "30-34",
                       ifelse(current_age < 40, "35-39",
                       ifelse(current_age < 45, "40-44", "45-50"))))
        fr_c        <- fr_means[current_grp]
        p_fail_adj  <- p_fail_fb_sc * fr_c
        up_cost_now <- up_costs_sc[current_grp]
        disc_f      <- 1 / (1 + disc_r)^cycle
        hcc         <- if (cycle == 1 || cycle == horizon) 0.5 else 1.0
        u_c         <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_fembloc else u_pc

        qalys_fb[cycle] <- (prop_pc_fb * u_c + prop_up_fb * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
        costs_fb[cycle] <- prop_up_fb * up_cost_now * disc_f
        new_up     <- prop_pc_fb * p_fail_adj
        prop_pc_fb <- prop_pc_fb * (1 - p_fail_adj) + prop_up_fb
        prop_up_fb <- new_up
      }
    }

    # ---- TL arm ----
    prop_pc_tl <- 1.0
    prop_up_tl <- 0.0
    costs_tl   <- numeric(horizon)
    qalys_tl   <- numeric(horizon)

    for (cycle in 1:horizon) {
      current_age <- mid_age + (cycle - 1)
      current_grp <- ifelse(current_age < 30, "25-29",
                     ifelse(current_age < 35, "30-34",
                     ifelse(current_age < 40, "35-39",
                     ifelse(current_age < 45, "40-44", "45-50"))))
      fr_c        <- fr_means[current_grp]
      p_fail_adj  <- p_fail_tl_sc * fr_c
      up_cost_now <- up_costs_sc[current_grp]
      disc_f      <- 1 / (1 + disc_r)^cycle
      hcc         <- if (cycle == 1 || cycle == horizon) 0.5 else 1.0
      u_c         <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_tl else u_pc

      qalys_tl[cycle] <- (prop_pc_tl * u_c + prop_up_tl * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
      costs_tl[cycle] <- prop_up_tl * up_cost_now * disc_f
      new_up     <- prop_pc_tl * p_fail_adj
      prop_pc_tl <- prop_pc_tl * (1 - p_fail_adj) + prop_up_tl
      prop_up_tl <- new_up
    }

    list(
      cost_fb = c0_fb            + sum(costs_fb),
      qaly_fb = sum(qalys_fb),
      cost_tl = tl_c0_vec_sc[i] + sum(costs_tl),
      qaly_tl = sum(qalys_tl)
    )
  })

  cost_fb  <- sum(sapply(res, `[[`, "cost_fb") * age_groups$prop)
  qaly_fb  <- sum(sapply(res, `[[`, "qaly_fb") * age_groups$prop)
  cost_tl  <- sum(sapply(res, `[[`, "cost_tl") * age_groups$prop)
  qaly_tl  <- sum(sapply(res, `[[`, "qaly_tl") * age_groups$prop)
  inc_cost <- cost_fb - cost_tl
  inc_qaly <- qaly_fb - qaly_tl
  icer     <- inc_cost / inc_qaly

  cat("\n---", label, "---\n")
  cat("FemBloc  | Cost:", round(cost_fb), "| QALYs:", round(qaly_fb, 4), "\n")
  cat("TL       | Cost:", round(cost_tl), "| QALYs:", round(qaly_tl, 4), "\n")
  cat("Inc cost:", round(inc_cost),
      "| Inc QALY:", round(inc_qaly, 4),
      "| ICER:", round(icer), "\n")

  list(label    = label,
       cost_fb  = round(cost_fb),
       qaly_fb  = round(qaly_fb, 4),
       cost_tl  = round(cost_tl),
       qaly_tl  = round(qaly_tl, 4),
       inc_cost = round(inc_cost),
       inc_qaly = round(inc_qaly, 4),
       icer     = round(icer))
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 1: FemBloc fail rate = 0
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sc1 <- run_scenario(
  p_fail_fb_sc = 0,
  label        = "S1: FemBloc fail rate = 0"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 2: TL CREST 10-year cumulative fail rate
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_fail_tl_crest_base <- 1 - (1 - 0.0185)^(1/10)
p_fail_tl_crest_low  <- 1 - (1 - 0.0151)^(1/10)
p_fail_tl_crest_high <- 1 - (1 - 0.0218)^(1/10)

cat("\nCREST TL annual fail rate:", round(p_fail_tl_crest_base, 6),
    "| CI:", round(p_fail_tl_crest_low, 6),
    "-", round(p_fail_tl_crest_high, 6), "\n")

sc2_base <- run_scenario(p_fail_tl_sc = p_fail_tl_crest_base,
                          label = "S2: TL CREST fail rate (base)")
sc2_low  <- run_scenario(p_fail_tl_sc = p_fail_tl_crest_low,
                          label = "S2a: TL CREST fail rate (low CI)")
sc2_high <- run_scenario(p_fail_tl_sc = p_fail_tl_crest_high,
                          label = "S2b: TL CREST fail rate (high CI)")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 3: Alternative device cost (±30%)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
fb_c0_low  <- rep(fembloc_total_cost - fembloc_device_cost +
                    fembloc_device_cost * 0.70, nrow(age_groups))
fb_c0_high <- rep(fembloc_total_cost - fembloc_device_cost +
                    fembloc_device_cost * 1.30, nrow(age_groups))

sc3_low  <- run_scenario(fb_c0_vec_sc = fb_c0_low,
                          label = "S3a: Device cost -30%")
sc3_high <- run_scenario(fb_c0_vec_sc = fb_c0_high,
                          label = "S3b: Device cost +30%")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 4: CREST UP outcome proportions
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
crest_raw   <- c(0.287, 0.182, 0.147, 0.329)
crest_props <- crest_raw / sum(crest_raw)

up_costs_crest <- setNames(
  as.vector(matrix(rep(crest_props, nrow(age_groups)),
                   nrow = nrow(age_groups), byrow = TRUE) %*%
              c(cost_live_birth, cost_induced_abortion,
                cost_miscarriage, cost_ectopic_pregnancy)),
  age_groups$group
)

cat("\nCREST UP proportions (normalised):", round(crest_props, 4), "\n")
cat("Base case UP cost (avg):", round(mean(up_state_costs)), "NOK\n")
cat("CREST UP cost (avg):    ", round(mean(up_costs_crest)),  "NOK\n")

sc4 <- run_scenario(up_costs_sc = up_costs_crest,
                     label = "S4: CREST UP outcome proportions")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 5: Unconfirmed crossover to TL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sc5 <- run_scenario(crossover = TRUE,
                     label = "S5: Unconfirmed crossover to TL")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCENARIO 6: Subgroup ICER by age group
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n========== S6: SUBGROUP ICER BY AGE GROUP ==========\n")

subgroup_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(age_groups), function(i) {
  ag      <- age_groups[i, ]
  horizon <- ag$horizon
  mid_age <- ag$midpoint
  disc_r  <- ag$disc_rate
  grp     <- ag$group
  fr_s    <- fr_means[grp]

  prop_pc_fb <- p_confirmed + p_unconfirmed * (1 - fr_s)
  prop_up_fb <- p_unconfirmed * fr_s
  costs_fb   <- numeric(horizon)
  qalys_fb   <- numeric(horizon)

  for (cycle in 1:horizon) {
    current_age <- mid_age + (cycle - 1)
    current_grp <- ifelse(current_age < 30, "25-29",
                   ifelse(current_age < 35, "30-34",
                   ifelse(current_age < 40, "35-39",
                   ifelse(current_age < 45, "40-44", "45-50"))))
    fr_c   <- fr_means[current_grp]
    p_fadj <- p_fail_fembloc * fr_c
    hcc    <- if (cycle == 1 || cycle == horizon) 0.5 else 1.0
    disc_f <- 1 / (1 + disc_r)^cycle
    u_c    <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_fembloc else u_pc

    qalys_fb[cycle] <- (prop_pc_fb * u_c + prop_up_fb * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
    costs_fb[cycle] <- prop_up_fb * up_state_costs[current_grp] * disc_f
    new_up     <- prop_pc_fb * p_fadj
    prop_pc_fb <- prop_pc_fb * (1 - p_fadj) + prop_up_fb
    prop_up_fb <- new_up
  }

  prop_pc_tl <- 1.0
  prop_up_tl <- 0.0
  costs_tl   <- numeric(horizon)
  qalys_tl   <- numeric(horizon)

  for (cycle in 1:horizon) {
    current_age <- mid_age + (cycle - 1)
    current_grp <- ifelse(current_age < 30, "25-29",
                   ifelse(current_age < 35, "30-34",
                   ifelse(current_age < 40, "35-39",
                   ifelse(current_age < 45, "40-44", "45-50"))))
    fr_c   <- fr_means[current_grp]
    p_fadj <- p_fail_tl * fr_c
    hcc    <- if (cycle == 1 || cycle == horizon) 0.5 else 1.0
    disc_f <- 1 / (1 + disc_r)^cycle
    u_c    <- if (cycle == 1) u_pc - u_ae_tl else u_pc

    qalys_tl[cycle] <- (prop_pc_tl * u_c + prop_up_tl * u_up) * hcc * disc_f
    costs_tl[cycle] <- prop_up_tl * up_state_costs[current_grp] * disc_f
    new_up     <- prop_pc_tl * p_fadj
    prop_pc_tl <- prop_pc_tl * (1 - p_fadj) + prop_up_tl
    prop_up_tl <- new_up
  }

  cost_fb  <- fembloc_total_cost + sum(costs_fb)
  qaly_fb  <- sum(qalys_fb)
  cost_tl  <- tl_total_cost      + sum(costs_tl)
  qaly_tl  <- sum(qalys_tl)
  inc_cost <- cost_fb - cost_tl
  inc_qaly <- qaly_fb - qaly_tl

  data.frame(
    Age_Group    = grp,
    Horizon_yrs  = horizon,
    Cost_FemBloc = round(cost_fb),
    Cost_TL      = round(cost_tl),
    QALY_FemBloc = round(qaly_fb, 4),
    QALY_TL      = round(qaly_tl, 4),
    Inc_Cost     = round(inc_cost),
    Inc_QALY     = round(inc_qaly, 4),
    ICER         = round(inc_cost / inc_qaly)
  )
}))

print(subgroup_results)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TABLE

               "S1: FemBloc fail rate = 0",

               extr(sc3_low,"inc_cost"),  extr(sc3_high,"inc_cost"),

  Inc_QALY = c(round(inc_qaly, 4),
               extr(sc1,"inc_qaly"),      extr(sc2_base,"inc_qaly"),
               extr(sc2_low,"inc_qaly"),  extr(sc2_high,"inc_qaly"),

               extr(sc4,"inc_qaly"),      extr(sc5,"inc_qaly")),

  ICER = c(round(icer_base),

)
```

```{r export_tables}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CEAC — UNINTENDED PREGNANCY METRIC
# Probability FemBloc is cost-effective at varying cost-per-UP thresholds.
# Note: no formal threshold exists for cost per UP avoided in Norway.
# Curve presented over a hypothetical range to inform decision-maker judgement.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Threshold range: NOK 0 to 100,000 per UP avoided
# (base case icer_up = -23,088, so FemBloc is in the SE quadrant —
#  decision-maker is asking: "is the cost saving worth the extra UPs?")
wtp_up_seq <- seq(0, 100000, by = 2500)

psa_inc_up_ce <- psa_up_fb - psa_up_tl  # positive = FemBloc has more UPs

ceac_up_agg <- sapply(wtp_up_seq, function(k)
  mean((psa_inc_cost + k * psa_inc_up_ce) < 0))
#FemBloc preferred when cost saving exceeds k * extra UPs incurred

ceac_up_df <- data.frame(
  threshold = wtp_up_seq,
  prob_fembloc = ceac_up_agg,
  prob_tl      = 1 - ceac_up_agg
)

# CEAF — optimal strategy at each threshold
ceac_up_df$optimal      <- ifelse(ceac_up_df$prob_fembloc >= 0.5,
                                   "FemBloc\u00ae", "TL")
ceac_up_df$prob_optimal <- ifelse(ceac_up_df$optimal == "FemBloc\u00ae",
                                   ceac_up_df$prob_fembloc,
                                   ceac_up_df$prob_tl)

# --- CEAC plot ---
ceac_up_plot <- ggplot(ceac_up_df, aes(x = threshold / 1000)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_fembloc), color = "#1B3A6B", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_tl),      color = "#CC0000",  linewidth = 1.0,
            linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = abs(icer_up) / 1000,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curve \u2014 Unintended Pregnancies",
    subtitle = paste0("Probability each strategy is preferred at varying ",
                      "cost-per-UP-avoided thresholds"),
    x        = "Maximum acceptable cost per UP avoided (NOK thousands)",
    y        = "Probability strategy is preferred",
    caption  = paste0(
      "Navy = FemBloc\u00ae preferred | Red dashed = TL preferred\n",
      "Grey dashed = base case |inc cost per UP| = NOK ",
      format(round(abs(icer_up)), big.mark = ","),
      " | No formal threshold exists for cost per UP avoided in Norway"
    )
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = abs(icer_up) / 1000 + 2, y = 0.15,
           label = paste0("NOK ", format(round(abs(icer_up)), big.mark = ",")),
           size = 3, color = "grey40", hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1B3A6B"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    plot.caption  = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8)
  )

# --- CEAF plot ---
ceaf_up_plot <- ggplot(ceac_up_df, aes(x = threshold / 1000)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_fembloc), color = "#1B3A6B",
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_tl), color = "#CC0000",
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = prob_optimal, color = optimal), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = abs(icer_up) / 1000,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FemBloc\u00ae" = "#1B3A6B",
                                 "TL"           = "#CC0000"),
                     name = "Optimal strategy") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Frontier \u2014 Unintended Pregnancies",
    subtitle = "Probability that the optimal strategy is preferred",
    x        = "Maximum acceptable cost per UP avoided (NOK thousands)",
    y        = "Probability optimal strategy is preferred",
    caption  = paste0(
      "Solid = CEAF (optimal strategy) | Dashed = CEAC for each strategy\n",
      "Grey dashed = base case |inc cost per UP| = NOK ",
      format(round(abs(icer_up)), big.mark = ","),
      " | No formal threshold exists for cost per UP avoided in Norway"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1B3A6B"),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    plot.caption    = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(ceac_up_plot)
print(ceaf_up_plot)

ggsave("fembloc_ceac_UP.png", ceac_up_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("fembloc_ceaf_UP.png", ceaf_up_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("UP-based CEAC and CEAF saved.\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CEAC — UP METRIC, BY AGE GROUP (Option B: proportional approximation)
#
# Per-age-group UP vectors were not stored in the PSA.
# Age-group UP contributions are approximated by scaling the aggregate
# PSA incremental UPs by each age group's deterministic share.
# This preserves PSA uncertainty while distributing it proportionally.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Deterministic per-age-group incremental UPs
det_inc_up_by_age <- sapply(1:nrow(age_groups), function(i)
  sum(results_fembloc[[i]]$up_vec - results_tl[[i]]$up_vec) * age_groups$prop[i])
names(det_inc_up_by_age) <- age_groups$group

det_inc_up_total <- sum(det_inc_up_by_age)

cat("Deterministic incremental UPs by age group:\n")
print(round(det_inc_up_by_age, 4))
cat("Total:", round(det_inc_up_total, 4), "\n")

# Age-group share of total incremental UPs
age_up_share <- det_inc_up_by_age / det_inc_up_total
cat("\nAge group share of incremental UPs:\n")
print(round(age_up_share, 3))

# Approximate PSA incremental UPs per age group
# psa_inc_up_ce = psa_up_fb - psa_up_tl (positive = FemBloc has more UPs)
psa_inc_up_by_age <- sapply(age_groups$group, function(grp)
  psa_inc_up_ce * age_up_share[grp])

# CEAC by age group
ceac_up_by_age <- sapply(age_groups$group, function(grp) {
  i      <- which(age_groups$group == grp)
  inc_c  <- psa_age_cost_fb[, i] - psa_age_cost_tl[, i]
  inc_up <- psa_inc_up_by_age[, grp]
  sapply(wtp_up_seq, function(k)
    mean((inc_c + k * inc_up) < 0))
})

# Build plotting data frame
ceac_up_age_df <- data.frame(
  threshold = wtp_up_seq,
  Aggregate = ceac_up_agg
)
ceac_up_age_df <- cbind(ceac_up_age_df, as.data.frame(ceac_up_by_age))

# Reshape
ceac_up_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(ceac_up_age_df,
                                     cols      = -threshold,
                                     names_to  = "group",
                                     values_to = "prob_fembloc")

# Plot
ceac_up_age_plot <- ggplot(ceac_up_long,
                            aes(x = threshold / 1000,
                                y = prob_fembloc,
                                color    = group,
                                linewidth = ifelse(group == "Aggregate", 1.2, 0.6),
                                linetype  = ifelse(group == "Aggregate",
                                                   "solid", "dashed"))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = abs(icer_up) / 1000,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#CC0000",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Aggregate" = "#1B3A6B",
    "25-29"     = "#4E9AF1",
    "30-34"     = "#2ECC71",
    "35-39"     = "#F39C12",
    "40-44"     = "#9B59B6",
    "45-50"     = "#E74C3C"
  )) +
  scale_linewidth_identity() +
  scale_linetype_identity() +
  labs(
    title    = "Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curve \u2014 Unintended Pregnancies",
    subtitle = "Probability FemBloc\u00ae is preferred, by age group",
    x        = "Maximum acceptable cost per UP avoided (NOK thousands)",
    y        = "Probability FemBloc\u00ae preferred",
    color    = "Group",
    caption  = paste0(
      "Red dashed = base case |ICER| = NOK ",
      format(round(abs(icer_up)), big.mark = ","),
      " per UP avoided\n",
      "Age-group curves approximate: PSA incremental UPs distributed ",
      "proportionally to deterministic age-group contributions"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1B3A6B"),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    plot.caption    = element_text(color = "grey50", size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(ceac_up_age_plot)
ggsave("fembloc_ceac_UP_byage.png", ceac_up_age_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("UP CEAC by age group saved as fembloc_ceac_UP_byage.png\n")
```
